ModMetaData.name: Jawa Fall Line Arrivals
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
FALL_LINE_ARRIVAL_MECHANISM_1 (design/RimUtinni/fall_line_arrival_mechanism_spec.md). The Fall Line's own creatures are ARRIVALS, never ambient biome fauna (owner, 2026-09-20, fall_line.md §8a): nothing here adds a wildAnimals row.
Ships, in this first pass: - Wreck falls (Band A): a ship wreck — hull rib, cargo section or fuel tank — comes down near the colony as a skyfaller. It is salvage, and it is a vermin nest: a few minutes after impact the first ship-vermin crawl out of it (mynocks cling to hull ribs, scavrats and womp rats nest in cargo, zhakkas feed at tanks), then it keeps producing slowly under Ship Vermin's shared cap of 12 per map. Strip it to end it. - The specimen (Band C): very rarely, one escape pod lands holding a single white lab rat — the one Earth animal on the belt, by the owner's ruling.
Where: only on Fall Line maps by default — a map whose tile carries the RUT_FallLine tile mutator, or whose world feature is named one of the Fall Line region names. A Mod Setting lets the events fire on any map instead.
Not here yet (filed): the feral survivor droids that flee (Band B), placing the RUT_FallLine mutator on the region's tiles of the frozen world, and the two wreckage creatures that are not yet ported.
Every switch is in Mod Settings ("Fall Line Arrivals").
